characters.summary: First mention: ““Sir Walter thought as how Mr Reggie’s things would fit you, sir,” said the butler.”

characters.name: Karolides

characters.name: Mr. Turnbull
characters.summary: First mention: “In the handkerchief was a local paper tied with string and addressed to Mr Turnbull—obviously meant to solace his midday leisure.”

characters.name: Paddock
characters.summary: First mention: “I woke next morning to hear my man, Paddock, making the deuce of a row at the smoking-room door.”

characters.name: Mr. Hannay
characters.summary: First mention: ““What was your job in Rhodesia, Mr Hannay?”

characters.name: Peter Pienaar
characters.summary: First mention: “But suddenly I remembered a thing I once heard in Rhodesia from old Peter Pienaar.”

characters.name: Sir Harry
characters.summary: First mention: ““Beg pardon, Sir Harry,” said one.”

characters.name: Royer
characters.summary: First mention: ““I got my Chief to speak to the First Lord and the Secretary for War, and they are bringing Royer over a day sooner.”

characters.name: Scaife
characters.summary: First mention: “Scaife, MacGillivray’s man, who had been in the Navy, knew the boat, and told me her name and her commander’s, so I sent off a wire to Sir Walter.”

characters.name: Whittaker
characters.summary: First mention: ““Royer dines with my Chief, and then comes to my house where four people will see him—Whittaker from the Admiralty, myself, Sir Arthur Drew, and General Winstanley.”

characters.name: Marmie
characters.summary: First mention: ““Marmie’ was a familiar figure, I understood, at balls and polo-weeks and country houses.”

characters.name: Jew
characters.summary: First mention: “Besides, the Jew was behind it, and the Jew hated Russia worse than hell.”

characters.name: Britain
characters.summary: First mention: “The second thing was that this war was going to come as a mighty surprise to Britain.”

characters.name: Lord Alloa
characters.summary: First mention: ““Lord Alloa,” Sir Walter said, reddening with anger.”

characters.name: Trafalgar Lodge
characters.summary: First mention: “The house was called Trafalgar Lodge, and belonged to an old gentleman called Appleton—a retired stockbroker, the house-agent said.”

characters.name: Bob
characters.summary: First mention: ““This will bring down my weight and my handicap, Bob.”
